events.title: Elding Classic Whale Watching
events.blurb: Reykjavik's original whale-watching operator sails Faxaflói bay hunting minkes, humpbacks, dolphins and porpoises. 2.5–3.5 hrs. July departures daily at 09:00, 11:00, 13:00, 15:00, 17:00 and 20:30 from the Old Harbour.

events.title: Elding Classic Puffin Watching
events.blurb: One-hour boat trip to the puffin colonies on Akurey/Lundey islands, just 15 minutes off the Old Harbour. Peak puffin season — July departures daily at 10:00, 12:00, 14:00, 16:00 and 18:00.

events.title: Elding Sea Angling Gourmet
events.blurb: Three-hour fishing trip on Faxaflói bay — catch cod, haddock or mackerel and the crew grills your catch on board. July departures daily at 09:00, 13:00 and 17:00.

events.title: Viðey Island Ferry
events.blurb: Five-minute hop to peaceful Viðey island — hiking, birdlife, Yoko Ono's Imagine Peace Tower and Viðeyjarstofa café. Summer ferries hourly from Skarfabakki 10:15–17:15 daily, plus Old Harbour departures at 11:50 and 14:50 (return ticket).

events.title: Special Tours Whale Watching
events.blurb: 2.5–3.5 hr whale-watching cruise on Faxaflói bay aboard the Andrea. Departure board confirms 28 Jul 2026 sailings at 09:00, 13:00 and 17:00, plus a faster Whale Watching Express (10:00, 14:00, 21:00) and RIB Express speedboat runs.

events.title: Puffin Express (Special Tours)
events.blurb: One-hour ride on 'Old Skuli' to Akurey island, home to ~30,000 nesting puffins. Departure board confirms 28 Jul 2026 sailings from 08:00 with multiple slots through the day (08:00, 09:30, 10:45...), plus a 12:00 RIB speedboat version.

events.title: Sky Lagoon
events.blurb: Oceanside geothermal lagoon with a 75-m infinity edge over the North Atlantic and the 7-step Skjól ritual (cold plunge, sauna with sea view, body scrub). Summer hours (Jun 21–Aug 20): daily 08:00–23:00. Saman pass from 14.990 kr, Sér from 17.990 kr. ~15 min from downtown.

events.title: Blue Lagoon
events.blurb: Iceland's most famous milky-blue geothermal spa, set in a lava field ~50 min from Reykjavik. Summer hours (Jun 15–Aug 20): daily 07:00–23:00; guests exit the water 30 min before closing. Comfort admission from 11.990 kr — pre-booking essential.

events.title: Laugardalslaug Swimming Pool
events.blurb: Iceland's largest public pool and a beloved local institution: 50-m outdoor pool, hot tubs, salt-water tub, cold plunge, steam room and water slides. Open Mon–Fri 06:30–22:00, Sat–Sun 08:00–22:00. Cheap, authentic and gloriously Icelandic.

events.title: Whales of Iceland Exhibition
events.blurb: Europe's largest whale exhibition — 23 life-size models including a 25-m blue whale, in an atmospheric deep-sea hall. Open daily 10:00–17:00 year-round; live guided tours daily at 11:00 and 15:00. Great pairing with a whale-watching trip.

events.title: FlyOver Iceland
events.blurb: Feet-dangling flight-ride over Iceland's glaciers, volcanoes and fjords on a 20-m spherical screen with wind, mist and scent effects. Open every day 09:00–19:30; rides depart every 15–20 minutes (whole experience ~35 min). Online tickets from 5.690 kr.

events.title: The Reykjavik Food Walk
events.blurb: Wake Up Reykjavik's #1-rated food tour: 3 hours, 5 local restaurants, 8+ tastes from lamb soup to Icelandic hot dogs with a local foodie guide. Runs every day with multiple departure times to choose from at booking (exact slots vary — the noon start here is nominal).

events.title: Free Walking Tour Reykjavik (CityWalk)
events.blurb: The famous 2-hour pay-what-you-want walk through downtown Reykjavik — Harpa, Parliament, City Hall, rainbow street — with history, elves and economic collapse told with a wink. Departs every day (booking calendar lists 10:30 and 13:30 slots); ends at City Hall.

events.title: Golden Circle Direct (Reykjavik Excursions)
events.blurb: The classic ~6-hour Golden Circle bus tour: Þingvellir National Park, Geysir geothermal area and Gullfoss waterfall. Runs year-round from BSÍ; booking widget confirms the Tue 28 Jul departure at 08:00. Optional hotel pickup 30 min before departure.
